build_sampling_repeat: repeat an executable n times with distinct cache keys and optional result update function
run_sampling_repeat_and_execute: repeat an executable n times in parallel and return a sequence of results
create_sampler_repeated: create a sampler that calls an inner strategy multiple times and returns a sequence of outputs
create_sampler_round_robin: create a sampler that round-robins across multiple inner samplers for each sample
review_sampler_protocol: review the Sampler protocol interface for generating samples from a conditional distribution
